name: Onboard an external manager
function: external manager research and investment operations
summary: Once the investment committee approves a new external mandate and the management agreement is signed, the manager research team coordinates a checklist across legal, operations, compliance, data and finance. Operations opens the custody account and settlement instructions, data management sets up the book of record and feeds, compliance codes the guidelines into monitoring rules and finance loads the fee schedule, then the account is funded in cash or in kind. Most of the elapsed time is waiting for the manager's documents and the custodian's account opening, and mismatches between the legal guidelines and the coded rules are a common source of later false or missed breaches.

baseline.org_archetype: A provincial public-sector asset manager of about 240 staff that consolidated its roster to about 80 to 120 external managers and added strategic partners and managed accounts.
baseline.notes: Legal negotiation of the agreement is the separate investment-legal-agreements process; funding cash is moved in the pool-rebalancing-cash-deployment process.

trigger: The investment committee approves a new external mandate and legal reports the management agreement as agreed.
end_state: The mandate is funded, reconciled, monitored by coded compliance rules and handed to monthly monitoring, or the onboarding is cancelled.

volume.seasonality: Bunched in 2020 and 2021 when the roster was rebuilt around fewer, larger strategic partners.

evidence.note: Roster cut from 200 to 124 in 2020 and planned at 80 to 85 by mid-2021 while new strategic partners and managed accounts were added; hires per month are the author's estimate.

roles.title: Senior analyst, manager research and operational due diligence

evidence.note: Coordinates onboarding of sub-advisers; FTE from simulated hands-on time; little headcount is left after monitoring and searches.

systems.name: Manager research database and due diligence questionnaire library
Email, video calls and collaboration suite
Document management system and virtual data rooms
Custodian portal (custody, accounting records, net asset value reports, cash and corporate action notices)
Trade confirmation matching and SWIFT messaging service

steps.name: Open the onboarding checklist
steps.description: After the investment committee approves a new mandate, the manager research analyst opens the onboarding checklist, records the mandate size, owning pool or client account, benchmark, target funding date and whether derivatives are allowed, and sends a kick-off email to legal, operations, compliance, data and finance.

evidence.note: Sub-adviser vetting and monitoring is a required policy; a transition and implementation plan is part of manager evaluation. Checklist form is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Request the manager's onboarding documents
steps.description: The analyst sends the manager the organisation's onboarding pack: authorised signatory and contact lists, registration evidence, insurance certificate, legal entity identifier, approved broker and counterparty list, data feed specifications and the reporting calendar.

evidence.note: Contract terms cover personnel, reporting, insurance and notices; list is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Wait for the manager's documents
steps.description: The manager's client service and operations teams gather the documents and return them, often in several batches with follow-up emails for missing items.

evidence.note: Two days to two weeks, based on general practice.

steps.name: Confirm the executed agreement and final guidelines
steps.description: Investment counsel confirms the management agreement is signed by both sides and circulates the final schedules: investment guidelines, benchmark, fee schedule, reporting and termination terms. A few onboardings stop here when the manager will not accept final terms.

error.defect_description: A guideline clause is ambiguous or differs between the agreement and the version sent to operations.

control.basis: Delegation of authority for executing investment management agreements

next.condition: manager does not sign final terms

evidence.note: Final documents, counsel's memo and compliance review precede execution; management agreement contents.

steps.name: Check the manager's registration, sanctions and conflicts
steps.description: The compliance analyst confirms the manager's registration or exemption to advise in Ontario, screens the firm and principals against sanctions lists and records any conflicts in the compliance file.

control.basis: National Instrument 31-103 adviser registration or exemption; OSC exemption order condition on vetting and monitoring sub-advisers

evidence.note: Sub-adviser due diligence policy; compliance review form before execution.

steps.name: Prepare the custody account opening package
steps.description: The reconciliations manager completes the custodian's account opening forms for a segregated account under the owning pool or client, lists the markets and currencies needed, attaches tax and structure documents and the manager's trading authority letter, and has authorised signers sign it.

error.defect_description: Missing market, tax form or signature, so the custodian returns the package.

control.basis: SOC 1 control objective: account opening documentation received, authenticated and set up accurately

evidence.note: Account opening needs legal, structure and tax documents, some wet-signed.

steps.name: Wait for the custodian to open the account and markets
steps.description: The custodian runs its own checks, opens the account and sub-accounts in each market through its agent banks and confirms account numbers; some emerging markets need local registrations that take weeks. Incomplete packages come back for correction.

evidence.note: Long timelines, agent banks and document chasing; durations are the author's estimate (one to six weeks).

steps.name: Set up settlement instructions and the broker list
steps.description: The reconciliations manager exchanges standard settlement instructions between the custodian and the manager, loads the approved broker list, sets up trade matching and confirms how foreign exchange will be executed and settled.

error.defect_description: A wrong settlement instruction causes the first trades to fail.

control.basis: Due diligence on brokers before they hold or access assets (OSC order condition) and approved broker list

next.condition: mandate may use futures or currency forwards

evidence.note: Broker and custodian due diligence required before access to assets.

steps.name: Put derivatives documents in place
steps.description: Investment counsel arranges futures give-up agreements with the manager's executing brokers and the organisation's clearing broker, and adds the account to existing ISDA and collateral agreements or agrees new ones for currency forwards.

evidence.note: Common practice for derivatives use by external managers; durations are the author's estimate.

steps.name: Set up the mandate in the book of record and data feeds
steps.description: The data management manager creates the portfolio in the investment book of record, assigns the benchmark, maps the manager's daily holdings and transactions files and the custodian feed, and sets up the account in the performance system and data warehouse.

error.defect_description: Security or account mapping error in the feed.

evidence.note: Common practice; the organisation file names the book of record, performance system and warehouse.

steps.name: Test the feeds with parallel files
steps.description: The data management manager loads test files from the manager and custodian, compares positions and transactions, fixes mapping errors and asks the manager to correct its file layout where needed.

next.condition: mapping or layout errors fixed and files re-tested

evidence.note: Testing with parallel files is common practice; failure share is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Set up the reconciliation
steps.description: A reconciliation analyst sets up daily position and cash matching between the manager's records, the custodian and the book of record in the reconciliation tool, with tolerances and break owners.

control.basis: SOC 1 control objective: positions and cash reconcile to custodian records with breaks researched and resolved

evidence.note: Reconciliation control objective; timely reconciliations in ongoing risk control.

steps.name: Code the guidelines into compliance rules
steps.description: The compliance analyst reads each guideline clause, decides how to measure it (issuer, rating, sector, country, derivatives and concentration limits), codes post-trade rules in the compliance engine and writes down each interpretation.

error.defect_description: A rule is coded differently from the legal guideline or a clause is missed.

control.basis: OSC exemption order: policies to prevent investments that contravene the restrictions in each IMA

evidence.note: Restrictions must be built into controls; guideline compliance is a baseline control objective.

steps.name: Review and approve the coded rules
steps.description: The chief compliance officer or a second analyst tests the coded rules against the guideline text and sample portfolios, sends back errors and refers unclear clauses to legal and the manager.

control.basis: Maker-checker review of compliance rule coding

next.condition: coding errors, or unclear wording clarified with legal and the manager

evidence.note: Second review of coded rules is common practice; shares are the author's estimate.

steps.name: Load the fee schedule and accrual
steps.description: The investment accountant enters the fee schedule (tiered rates, minimums, any performance fee, hurdle and high-water mark) in the fee calculation workbook, sets up the accrual in the accounting records and records invoice contacts.

error.defect_description: A fee tier or performance fee term is entered wrongly.

evidence.note: Fee, invoicing and payment terms in the agreement; fee calculation is a control area.

steps.name: Add the mandate to the monitoring scorecard
steps.description: The analyst adds the mandate to the manager research database with its benchmark, watch list criteria, reporting calendar and meeting schedule so monthly monitoring starts with the first report.

evidence.note: Sub-advisers must be monitored; review criteria and frequency.

steps.name: Hold the readiness review and approve go-live
steps.description: The director of manager research walks the checklist with operations, compliance, data and finance and signs off funding only when the account, instructions, feeds, reconciliation, rules and fees are ready.

control.basis: Operational readiness sign-off before funding a new mandate

next.condition: an item is not ready; re-reviewed after the fix

evidence.note: Readiness review is common practice; 18% not ready is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Agree the funding plan and send the funding notice
steps.description: The analyst agrees with total portfolio management whether the account is funded in cash from the pool or client account or in kind from a terminated mandate, fixes the date and sends the manager its cash notice.

evidence.note: Funding is often coordinated with a transition from a legacy manager; timing is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Wait for cash or assets to arrive
steps.description: The cash transfer settles, or the custodian moves securities in kind from the legacy account, and the manager confirms it can start trading.

evidence.note: One to ten days depending on cash or in-kind funding.

steps.name: Reconcile the opening positions
steps.description: The reconciliation analyst compares opening positions and cash in the manager's file, the custodian and the book of record and chases breaks with the manager and custodian.

evidence.note: Breaks researched and resolved; break share is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Run the first compliance check
steps.description: The compliance analyst reviews the first post-trade compliance run on live holdings, clears false alerts caused by coding and confirms real issues with the manager.

next.condition: false alerts show a coding error

evidence.note: Common practice; the organisation file notes gaps between legal guidelines and coded rules cause later breaches.

steps.name: Fix the coding error and re-approve the rule
steps.description: The compliance analyst corrects the rule that raised false alerts, documents the new interpretation and has it approved by the chief compliance officer before the next daily run.

control.basis: Maker-checker review of compliance rule changes

evidence.note: Common practice; time is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Confirm go-live and hand over to monitoring
steps.description: The analyst confirms the mandate is live to the portfolio manager, operations, compliance and finance, files the executed documents and set-up evidence and closes the checklist.

evidence.note: Common practice.

exceptions.name: Custodian returns the account package
exceptions.description: A missing market, tax form or signature sends the package back and adds one to two weeks.

exceptions.name: Derivatives documentation
exceptions.description: Mandates allowed to use futures or currency forwards need give-up and ISDA documents, often the longest item.

exceptions.name: Guideline wording unclear or coded wrongly
exceptions.description: The reviewer finds coding errors, or a clause cannot be coded as written and legal clarifies it with the manager, sometimes by side letter.

exceptions.name: Not ready at the readiness review
exceptions.description: A feed, reconciliation or rule is incomplete and funding is postponed.

exceptions.name: False compliance alerts after funding
exceptions.description: The first run shows coding errors that must be fixed and re-approved.

benchmarks.unit: calendar days from committee approval to a funded, monitored mandate
benchmarks.population: New segregated external mandates at a Canadian public asset manager

evidence.note: Author's estimate; State Street research cited by MJ Hudson found 70% of US manager transitions took one to twelve months from decision to implementation.
Down from 200 in mid-2019.

pain_points.description: Custody account and market openings depend on paper forms, wet signatures and agent banks, so they set the critical path and are hard to track.
Guidelines are re-keyed by hand from the legal text into compliance rules; interpretation differences cause false alerts or missed breaches later.

evidence.note: Restrictions must be built into controls; the organisation file names this gap as a common source of breaches.

pain_points.description: Coordination runs on a spreadsheet checklist and email across five teams and the manager, so items stall without anyone noticing until the readiness review.

evidence.note: Typical of firms onboarding one or two mandates a month.

pain_points.description: Feed mapping needs several test rounds with the manager's operations team.

evidence.note: General practice.

sources.title: The model manager, Commission and Director decisions (exemption order, June 2017)
sources.supports: Board-approved policies required for: a compliance system and a chief compliance officer; books and records; conflicts including insider trading and front running; prevention of any investment that contravenes the investment restrictions set out in each member's IMA; a KYC policy; an escalation process for member concerns or complaints that may be set out in the IMA; a due diligence process for vetting and monitoring sub-advisers; due diligence on custodians and brokers before they hold or access assets.

sources.title: Asset Manager's Guide to SOC 1 (June 2017)
sources.supports: Baseline control objectives: documentation for opening and modifying accounts is received, authenticated and set up accurately and timely; trades follow portfolio guidelines and account restrictions (client investment guideline and restriction compliance); positions and cash reconcile to custodian records with breaks researched and resolved; client account statements are complete, correct and timely; fee calculation and billing listed as an area to consider.

sources.title: Selecting Third-Party Investment Professionals for Pension Fund Assets (best practice)
sources.supports: Management agreement should name account personnel and fiduciary duties, commit to the investment policy, require prompt notice of ownership or key personnel changes, set reporting, insurance, fee, invoicing and payment terms and termination procedures for either party; review a transition and implementation plan; ongoing risk control with at least annual compliance review, guideline compliance checks and timely reconciliations.

sources.title: External Investment Manager and Vehicle Selection Policy and Procedures (IMD-POL-1001)
sources.publisher: North Carolina Department of State Treasurer, Investment Management Division
sources.supports: After approval, the director and external counsel negotiate contracts with in-house legal and compliance; final approval package holds final documents, counsel's memo comparing terms with preferred terms, the recommendation memo, a signed compliance review form and conflict certifications before execution.

sources.title: Transforming custody account opening with technology (roundtable)
sources.supports: Custody account opening needs legal agreements, structure documents, tax forms and regulatory disclosures, some notarised, apostilled or wet-signed; documents reviewed by at least two people in separate teams; KYC and AML run in parallel to shorten opening time; pain points are paper forms, email back-and-forth, lack of status visibility and many agent banks; three main parties (investors and their managers, global custodians, sub-custodians).

sources.title: The model manager 2020 Annual Report
sources.supports: 200 fund managers (including underlying funds) in mid-2019, 124 at end 2020 and a plan for about 80 to 85 by mid-2021; fund-of-funds eliminated; one-time manager transition costs in 2020 from repositioning public equity portfolios; hedge fund portfolio moved from fund-of-funds to direct hedge fund investments on a managed account platform; senior roles filled to support more direct and co-investing; a client engagement protocol rolled out to all employees in December 2020 setting guidelines and accountability for client communications.

sources.title: The model manager posts solid 2020 return, meets benchmark index (news release)
sources.publisher: The model manager via Cision Newswire
sources.supports: External manager roster cut from 200 to 124 in 2020, fund-of-funds eliminated, new strategic partnerships formed and about $10 million of investment management fees saved.

sources.title: Top Ten Tips For Transition Management (MJ Hudson)
sources.supports: Delays from infrequent meetings, searches, legal negotiation and operations; implementation shortfall is the industry standard cost measure; transition managers chosen on cost estimates should also be judged on solution and conflicts; target managers are not always best placed to transition legacy assets; hedge FX during transitions; citing State Street research, 70% of US transitions in 2015 had a delay or implementation period of 1 to 12 months.

sources.title: Selecting, Reviewing and Replacing Managers
sources.publisher: Western University pension plans (Joint Pension Board)
sources.supports: On a terminate recommendation: withhold future cash flows, terminate and invoke a pre-agreed backup manager, search for a replacement, identify and estimate the costs of changing managers with strategies to minimise them, and identify administrative issues such as notification periods and termination clauses; administrative problems include failure to report and incomplete documentation.

assumptions: The workflow starts after committee approval with the agreement close to signature; negotiation itself is in the investment-legal-agreements process, so the trigger shares split between the two inputs.

Custody account opening, derivatives documents and data set-up overlap in practice; the simulation runs them in sequence with short waits for the overlapping steps, which may overstate elapsed time slightly.
The chief compliance officer role stands in for the second reviewer of coded rules; in some months a second compliance analyst does it.
In-kind funding from a terminated mandate is coordinated with the termination and transition workflow.

Roles, titles and hourly costs come from the organisation file; full-time equivalents are set from simulated hands-on time times volume. The manager research analysts have under one FTE left after monitoring, searches and fund commitments, which this workflow stays within.
